embedded_stage_movies.title: Ea/Ep 顶面缩小与细胞内移
embedded_stage_movies.credit: Bob Goldstein，UNC Chapel Hill；NIGMS 影片 3334，相关研究 Roh-Johnson 等（2012）
embedded_stage_movies.description: 绿色为 myosin，红色为细胞膜，蓝色伪彩标出内移细胞。留意顶面轮廓怎样缩小、邻居怎样覆盖原来的位置；蓝色标注用于定位细胞，不是另一种分子信号。
embedded_stage_movies.placement: Beginning of the developmental stage section
embedded_stage_movies.usage: Remote HTML5 video embed; no local video copy or re-encoding. Source credits and acquisition conditions retained.

embedded_stage_movies.title: 背侧表皮从两列到交错排列
embedded_stage_movies.credit: Hardin Lab，WormBook Movie 2；影像 E. Williams-Masson
embedded_stage_movies.description: 野生型胚胎的背侧 DIC 影像，前端在左，原始采样间隔为 30 s。细胞先形成楔形，随后左右交错，逐渐排成横跨中线的一列。可以先追踪尖端，再比较细胞主体何时跟上。
embedded_stage_movies.placement: Beginning of the developmental stage section
embedded_stage_movies.usage: Remote HTML5 video embed; no local video copy or re-encoding. Source credits and acquisition conditions retained.

embedded_stage_movies.title: 腹侧表皮向中线推进并封闭开口
embedded_stage_movies.credit: Hardin Lab，WormBook Movie 5；影像 Mathias Koeppen
embedded_stage_movies.description: 野生型胚胎的腹侧 DIC 影像，前端在左，原始采样间隔为 2 min。先看两侧前缘如何接近，再看初次接触以后，后方剩余开口怎样继续封闭。
embedded_stage_movies.placement: Beginning of the developmental stage section
embedded_stage_movies.usage: Remote HTML5 video embed; no local video copy or re-encoding. Source credits and acquisition conditions retained.

embedded_stage_movies.title: 原肠胚末期的腹侧裂隙封闭
embedded_stage_movies.credit: Hardin Lab，WormBook Movie 1；影像 H. N. Cinar 与 D. Patel
embedded_stage_movies.description: 腹侧 DIC 影像，前端在左，原始采样间隔为 60 s。腹外侧神经母细胞向中线靠近，裂隙由后向前消失；这是表皮包裹之前的事件。
embedded_stage_movies.placement: Beginning of the developmental stage section
embedded_stage_movies.usage: Remote HTML5 video embed; no local video copy or re-encoding. Source credits and acquisition conditions retained.

embedded_stage_movies.title: 从短粗胚胎到细长身体
embedded_stage_movies.credit: Hardin Lab，WormBook Movie 9；影像 E. Cox，Pettitt 等（2003）
embedded_stage_movies.description: 野生型胚胎的侧面 DIC 影像，前端在左，原始采样间隔为 60 s。前半段适合观察身体变细、轴向变长；影片还延续到后期，出现弯曲后，应沿身体轮廓追踪长度。
embedded_stage_movies.placement: Beginning of the developmental stage section
embedded_stage_movies.usage: Remote HTML5 video embed; no local video copy or re-encoding. Source credits and acquisition conditions retained.

embedded_stage_movies.title: 肌肉抽动中的表皮变形与继续伸长
embedded_stage_movies.description: 光片成像中的 DLG-1::RFP 标记表皮连接。观察肌肉抽动时连接的反复伸展与回缩，再比较较长时间内细胞群长度的变化；单次脉动和长期伸长叠加在同一段影像中。

embedded_stage_movies.title: 卵壳内的三维弯曲与旋转
